title: autocmd causes use-after-free

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- `nvim --version`: NVIM v0.5.0-824-ge786fb5af - `vim -u DEFAULTS` (version: ) behaves differently? The vim does not have WinScrolled autocmd. - Operating system/version: N/A - Terminal name/version: N/A - `$TERM`: N/A ### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC` #### repos.vim ```vim vs enew autocmd WinScrolled * call nvim_win_close(0, v:true) " or vs enew call setbufvar(0, 'bufhidden', 'wipe') autocmd WinScrolled * call nvim_buf_delete(0, {'force' : v:true}) ``` ``` nvim -u NORC -S repos.vim ``` ### Actual behaviour use-after-free is occurring. ### Expected behaviour Invalid memory accesses do not occur.

From the user's point of view, I don't think there is any scrolling going on, just opening and closing the window. #### repos2.vim ```vim vs autocmd WinScrolled * let g:scrolled = 1 q ``` ``` nvim -u NORC -S repos2.vim :echo g:scrolled 1 ``` Cc: @romgrk, @bfredl
